title: Woman at Sunset Window
description: A woman with dark hair in a bun sits on a wooden bench in a room, holding a pink rose and gazing out a large window at a vibrant sunset. The left wall and part of the scene are covered in an intricate, overlapping floral pattern with teal, pink, and gold motifs that blend into the realistic interior.
prompt: A contemplative woman with her hair in a bun sits on a wooden bench inside a room, gently holding a pink rose while looking out a large open window at a warm orange and purple sunset over distant trees. The left side of the image features a large overlapping translucent floral pattern with roses, leaves, and circular motifs in teal, pink, and gold that partially covers the realistic scene, creating a surreal layered effect.
